# Proofs {#sec-app-proofs}

::: {.proof}
## Proof of @prp-did

Write $y_t(1)$ and $y_t(0)$ for potential outcomes with and without treatment. The
treated group is observed treated after the policy, so
$$
E[y_1 - y_0 \mid T] = E[y_1(1) - y_1(0) \mid T] + E[y_1(0) - y_0(0) \mid T].
$$
The first term is the ATT. By @asm-parallel, the second term equals
$E[y_1(0) - y_0(0) \mid C] = E[y_1 - y_0 \mid C]$. Subtracting the control group's
change leaves the ATT.
:::
